original: He figured that he could use this to earn some cash、 so he went to go check it out。 When he got there、 he apparently saw one hell of a scene。
contexto:
Dialogue. Adjacent lines in the same event:
I heard about the rumor of Demon Lord Prier about 2 days ago。 The Escargot Gang and I stopped by a port for a short while to stock up on supplies。
This intel comes from a freelance demon hunter、 but it appears that a magic gate has recently appeared in a cave around Vinaigrette。
There was a young and beautiful girl all alone who was slaying demons left and right without a single care in the world。
And then the girl started speaking。 She said、  I am Demon Lord Prier! The girl who reigns above all demons!
